# Citetome

> The AEO and GEO control plane for multilingual SMBs. Citetome audits and governs how a brand is found, cited, and trusted by AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), with a signed governance pact and an append-only audit log.

Operated by Yossra Benzad, Copenhagen, Denmark. Live product: https://api.citetome.com (Fly.io London region).

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://citetome.com/): product overview, features, FAQ
- [Pricing](https://citetome.com/pricing/): audit and managed plan tiers in EUR
- [Audit](https://citetome.com/audit/): request a one-off audit
- [Legal](https://citetome.com/legal/): imprint, privacy, terms, governance pact, DPA

## Live endpoints

- [Customer dashboard](https://api.citetome.com/customer): per-tenant view
- [Governance posture](https://api.citetome.com/governance): public governance state
- [Knowledge graph](https://api.citetome.com/kg/sitemap.xml): public knowledge graph
- [LLMs registry](https://api.citetome.com/llms.txt): registered sites
